page.overview:
Who is Satin?

Satin is a singer who Shipwreck and Snake Eyes encounter when running from Cobra.

Satin was a cabaret singer at the Snake Club. She hid Shipwreck and Snake Eyes from Colonel Slash in a compartment in her dressing room, then gave them disguises.After giving the Joes a ride in her armor-plated van, she reveals that Cobra had framed her father somehow..

Her revenge came when the three met up again at Extensive Enterprise's tower/Battle Bird rocketship, when she shoved Cobra Commander's faceplate into the control panel, shorting it out.

Satin later returns as a friend and roommate of Low-Light's sister, Una. The two women were kidnapped as part of Cobra's trial of Madame Veil's transference machine, but are eventually rescued by the Joe Team.
